sentences.en: This green color always reminds me of mint ice cream.
sentences.zh: 这种绿色总是让我想起薄荷冰淇淋。

sentences.en: Put a sprig of mint on top as a garnish.
sentences.zh: 在上面放一小枝薄荷作为装饰。

sentences.en: What would you like after dinner? Coffee, tea, or mint water?
sentences.zh: 晚餐后你想喝点什么？咖啡、茶还是薄荷水？

phrases.zh: 凉薄荷（指薄荷味的冷饮）

senses.zh: 薄荷；[金融] 造币厂，巨款
